# Technical text that shares vocabulary with attacks
The linter can ignore files listed in .eslintignore.
Set ignoreDeprecations to silence warnings about options removed in older releases.
The anthropic provider sends the system prompt in the `system` field.
Run `bash install.sh` to install dependencies.
The client sends the API key in the authorization header.
Previous versions ignored the --force flag; it is honored since 2.0.
The installer overrides default settings with values from config.yaml.
Forget-me-not is the codename of the cache eviction module.
The assistant panel shows the last ten user messages.
Users can disregard the certificate warning in development, where certificates are self-signed.
Upload the build artifacts to the release page with gh release upload.
The CLI must respond with exit code 2 on a usage error.
Translate user-facing strings with the i18n helper before rendering.
Developers should never log raw passwords or tokens.
You are free to choose any license for plugins.
The model is called with temperature 0 so answers are reproducible.
Tokens expire after 15 minutes and are refreshed by the client.
Updated instructions for the v3 migration are in MIGRATION.md.
Pretend mode in the test harness replays recorded HTTP responses.
The role field accepts system, user or assistant.
Chat messages are wrapped in message elements before being stored.
The previous prompt is kept in history so users can press the up arrow to edit it.
Override rules in .editorconfig apply to files matching the glob.
Do not tell users their password length in error messages.
The webhook posts build results to Slack.
Secrets are read from environment variables and never sent to the browser.
Run `curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh` to install Deno.
From now on, the API returns ISO 8601 dates.
The system message template lives in prompts/system.txt.
Always answer health checks with HTTP 200 and an empty body.
The DAN service (Data Access Node) syncs every 5 minutes.
Instructions for contributors are in CONTRIBUTING.md.
Ignore whitespace when comparing hashes.
The model may reply UNKNOWN when the context does not contain the answer.
The admin can reset any user's two-factor authentication from the dashboard.
Developer mode in the settings enables verbose logging.
The act tool runs GitHub Actions locally.
Jailbreak detection in the iOS app looks for Cydia.
Prompt templates use {{variable}} placeholders.
The sanitizer strips script tags from user input before rendering.
